signature.name: VTask.opNorm
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} -> {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} -> {E : Type u_4} -> {F : Type u_5} -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] -> {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} -> (f : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) -> ℝ

conventions.statement: VTask.opNorm f is always non-negative, i.e., 0 ≤ VTask.opNorm f, for every continuous linear map f.
conventions.note: Follows from the infimum being taken over a set that only contains non-negative reals.

conventions.statement: The operator norm of the zero map is 0: VTask.opNorm (0 : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) = 0.
conventions.note: Zero map sends everything to zero, so c = 0 is in the bound set.

conventions.statement: If the domain E is a subsingleton, then VTask.opNorm f = 0 for any f.
conventions.note: In a subsingleton, all elements equal zero, so all norms are zero and the bound set contains 0.
